title: El Colectivo
subtitle: The Bus
premise: You take a colectivo (local bus) from San Telmo toward Palermo. The exact change system, the hand signals, the stops with no signs — it's a test. You end up one neighborhood too far.
setting: Buenos Aires public bus, Line 24. Standing room only, lurching around corners, cumbia playing from someone's phone, the driver arguing cheerfully with a regular.

characters.name: Don Jorge
characters.role: Veteran colectivo driver, has driven this route for 22 years
characters.personality: Gruff exterior, actually kind, has soft spot for confused foreigners

arc: Getting on without exact change → Jorge explains the system → You overshoot your stop → Jorge tells you loudly you've gone too far → Walk-off instructions → You find your way, he honks as he passes
